sci.community.phones-and-internet.L2.note: Khan's internet videos (Internet 101: packets, routers, wires, HTTP) are written for older learners and adults, too advanced for ages 6 to 8. Dropped.

sci.health.breathe-and-stretch.L1.note: Khan's breathing and lung videos are biology for older students and medical courses (NCLEX, MCAT). None fit ages 6 to 8. Nothing on stretching or yoga for this age.

videos.title: Chromatography | Middle school physics | Khan Academy
videos.matches: Shows how a mixture of colours separates as a liquid carries them along, the idea behind the wet-paper dye test.

videos.title: Decibel Scale | Mechanical waves and sound | Physics | Khan Academy
videos.matches: Explains why the decibel scale is not ordinary counting, which is the card on two horns making only 3 decibels more than one.
